title: University of Agriculture Faisalabad Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: University of Agriculture Faisalabad Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1983
UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE FAISALABAD (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend the University of
Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 6th August, 1983]
No. Legis. 3 (14)/83.-The following Ordinance by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance
may be called the University of Agriculture Faisalabad (Amendment) Ordinance,
1983.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment in section 46 of Act No. XII of 1973

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1983
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1983
UNIVERSITY OF AGRICULTURE
FAISALABAD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance further to amend
the University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 6th August, 1983]
No. Legis. 3 (14)/83.-The following
Ordinance by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment in section 46 of
Act No. XII of 1973.-In the University of Agriculture Faisalabad Act, 1973,
in section 46, for the words "Secretary Education" the words
"Secretary Agriculture" shall be substituted.
